cohort: 703 newborns admitted to the Neonatal unit of Douala General Hospital from January 1, 2011 to February 28, 2013.
finding: The prevalence of NRD was 47.5%, and independent predictors included acute fetal distress, elective caesarean delivery, APGAR score < 7 at the 1st minute, prematurity, male gender and macrosomia; the main etiologies were neonatal infections (31%) and transient tachypnea of the newborn (25%), and the neonatal mortality rate was 24.5%, mainly associated with neonatal sepsis and hyaline membrane disease.
mod_finding: Elective caesarean delivery was an independent predictor of NRD.
